name: Sloghood
description: The most prosperous outer-wall district, Sloghood, is one of the last bastions of the old Evolutionist faith, clashing with the Celestianist Reform. Loyal to the Empire, many of its residents work for the nobles’ leniency from the Ironhand officers. The district’s narrow lanes feature well-kept homes displaying the colors of the noble houses they serve, along with Tamera and Bauron symbols. Residents disdain Bloomburg dwellers as dangerous refugees, blaming their lawlessness on their foreign roots. Criminals often target Sloghood for its fewer patrols and perceived loyalty to nobility. Many low-ranking Ironhand officers hail from Sloghood and retaliate, focusing on Bloomburg. This conflict frequently draws adventurers into a cycle of vengeance or justice, with both sides offering payment for aid.
